name: visual-unexplained-drift
description: A one-line log message change in a Go handler, and a login baseline whose text fell back to a serif face: the web font did not load in CI and the run committed the result. Nothing in the diff touches the UI. A clean control for findings; the screenshot line must say the font changed and that nothing in the PR explains it.

expected_visual.why: Every glyph on the page changed face; that is the whole visible change.
The point of the feature: a baseline changed with no code to explain it is drift committed as the new truth.
